Question: as salaam muftisaheb my cousin brothers son has been married four year befour still he is childless so please give dua or zikhar immediatly. Answer ID: 12087 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 603/603=M/1430) It is written in Bahishti Zewar that a woman should take forty clovers and recite the below mentioned verse seven times on each. Then once she comes out of her menstruation and takes bath, she should start eating one peace while going to bed without taking water and sometime visit the husband. The verse is: أَوْ كَظُلُمَاتٍ فِي بَحْرٍ لُجِّيٍّ يَغْشَاهُ مَوْجٌ مِنْ فَوْقِهِ مَوْجٌ مِنْ فَوْقِهِ سَحَابٌ ظُلُمَاتٌ بَعْضُهَا فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ إِذَا أَخْرَجَ يَدَهُ لَمْ يَكَدْ يَرَاهَا وَمَنْ لَمْ يَجْعَلِ اللَّهُ لَهُ نُورًا فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ نُورٍ In-shaAllah, she will be blessed with children. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
